preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m_code WHERE code_name = 'RELATIONSHIP'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_code_value (id, code_id, code_value, code_description, order_position, code_score, is_active, is_mandatory) SELECT nextval('m_code_value_id_seq'), code.id, requested.code_value, 'Required by Arissto family-reference migration', requested.order_position, NULL, TRUE, FALSE FROM m_code code CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('Padre/Madre', 9), ('Esposo(a)/Pareja', 10), ('Primo(a)', 11), ('Tío(a)', 12), ('Sobrino(a)', 13), ('Cuñado(a)', 14), ('Suegro(a)', 15), ('Yerno/Nuera', 16), ('Abuelo(a)', 17), ('Nieto(a)', 18), ('Sin especificar', 19) ) requested(code_value, order_position) WHERE code.code_name = 'RELATIONSHIP' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_code_value existing WHERE existing.code_id = code.id AND LOWER(existing.code_value) = LOWER(requested.code_value) );

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM m_code_value value USING m_code code WHERE value.code_id = code.id AND code.code_name = 'RELATIONSHIP' AND value.code_description = 'Required by Arissto family-reference migration' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_family_members member WHERE member.relationship_cv_id = value.id);
